convert_gltf_to_glb: run the gltf2glb script to convert a glTF JSON file to a binary GLB file
convert_gltf_to_glb_no_embed: run the gltf2glb script with --no-embed to convert glTF to GLB without embedding binary data
convert_gltf_to_glb_bundle_images: run the gltf2glb script with --bundle-images to embed image files into the GLB binary buffer
convert_gltf_to_glb_custom_output: run the gltf2glb script with -o to specify a custom output GLB file path
pad_size_32b: call pad_size_32b to calculate the number of padding bytes needed for 32-bit alignment
